title: Channels
objective: Users connect, check, start, stop and remove chat channel accounts, decide who may message the agent, look up contacts and ids, and send, broadcast, poll, react, edit, pin and thread messages through the CLI, the Control UI and the agent message tool, and talk to the agent from chat apps in direct chats, groups, threads and ambient rooms, normally with several channels running, channel turns in flight, drafts streaming and deliveries queued, and with hot reloads, platform failures, retries, restarts and crashes around them.

phases.intent: A user has the conformance channel, a Telegram account on the platform shim and a Discord account on the fixture all running at once; the probe status and channel status are observed.
A person on the conformance channel has asked the agent something the mock model is still answering; the started inbound and its observations are recorded.
An operator adds a second Telegram account to the running Gateway from the CLI with environment-backed setup; the add output, the channel list and the status are recorded.

An operator opens the Channels page, chooses Set up on an available channel, walks the setup wizard (answer fields, secret reveal, docs and external link, Continue, Cancel) and also starts it from Browse all and from a detail's Run setup; screens and wizard responses are recorded.
An operator runs the configure wizard's channel section and the guided channels add flow under a pseudo-terminal with scripted answers; the wizard transcript and resulting status are recorded.
An operator runs channels add and channels login from a CLI profile whose state path differs from the running Gateway's service; outputs are recorded.

An operator installs third-party channel plugins built on the legacy shared setup adapter, the pre-rename runtime alias and deprecated identifier fields, and adds and messages through them; outputs are recorded.

A user repeats link a channel account by QR login under each documented state of that operation, observing what each state changes.

An operator in an explicit multi-agent setup without a System Agent lists channels, tries a guided add without --agent and sends a message; outputs are recorded.
A user reads the configured channel list, recorded and probed status, and Doctor findings; the summaries are recorded.
A user checks channel status and lists pairing requests while the Gateway is stopped, observing the config-only summaries and the offline pairing listing.
An operator asks what each channel account can do, for all channels and for Telegram, and Kova's preflight reads the packaged message contracts; capability output is recorded.
A user asks what the Discord account can do for one channel target while a channel turn is in flight, observing the capability output.
An operator tails channel logs for all channels and for Telegram while channels run; log output is recorded.
An operator stops and restarts the conformance channel account through the Gateway and asks to start a disabled, a suppressed and a secret-missing account; the RPC responses and status are recorded.
A user stops and starts one Telegram account through the Gateway methods and the admin HTTP RPC while it is connected, observing the stopped and started outcomes and status.
An operator looks up self, peers, groups and group members on Telegram and the conformance channel and resolves names to ids; directory and resolve output is recorded.
A user resolves channel and user names and lists self, peers, groups and group members on Telegram and Discord, observing the ids returned.
